messages:
ashley: incident-bot alerted: SLO breach on inference-gateway streaming p99 > 3.2s for 5m, p95 elevated. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: [ALERT] inference-gateway.streaming.latency.p99 = 3.24s (SLO 2.0s) · 5m · triggered at 3162467960 · graph: https://metrics/redwood/streams/316246
ryan_oncall: ack. I'm looking. Any customer reports yet?
devin: looking at ingress: I see a spike in controlplane-configfetch errors hitting 502/503 from config-proxy around 3162467810..3162468000. Also increased retries from edge.
maria: seeing tokenstore 429s correlated with the same window. logs:
```
2026-02-14T12:06:45Z tokenstore: POST /v1/tokens (503) user=svc-inference retry=3
2026-02-14T12:06:47Z config-proxy: GET /cfg/active (502) correlation_id=abc123
```
devin: looks like feature-flag propagation calls spiked — several services hammering configstore on deploys. Could be hotkeys from a rollout.
sre-bot: Suggest temporary mitigation: enable config-cache-only fallback on inference-gateway and increase tokenstore read capacity. Also consider short-circuiting feature flag fanout.
ashley: @devin please check recent canary rollouts and any automated fanout jobs. @maria check tokenstore capacity/quotas and which customers hit 429s. @ryan_oncall coordinate on live mitigations.
pmartin: CS already got 2 tickets about streaming stalls for high-throughput customers. Marking potential customer impact: partial stalls, retries, not data loss.
dry: (typo) — ignore
ryan_oncall: I'm going to flip `inference-gateway.config_fallback=cache-only` for the cluster and disable rollout fanout temporarily. Doing a quick patch now.
eng-ledger: +1, also we can short-circuit evaluation of non-critical flags to reduce queries.
devin: found a recent deploy by ff-service around 3162467700 that posted flags to all regions. That matches timing.
```
curl -X POST https://ff-service/api/v1/publish -d '{"flags": [...], "scope":"global"}'
```
maria: tokenstore shows throttle rule triggered for service account `svc-edge`. I increased the tokenstore per-second quota for that account as an emergency. Monitoring.
ryan_oncall: applied config_fallback patch. Will monitor p99.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation task created: CONFIG-FALLBACK-316246 · assigned to ryan_oncall · ETA 5m
devin: rolled a quick hotfix to ff-service to change publish from fanout to async queueing. pushed at 3162468202.
maria: tokenstore 429 rate decreasing after quota bump.
ryan_oncall: metrics: p99 dropped from 3.24s -> 1.8s after config_fallback and throttles. p95 stable. link: https://metrics/redwood/streams/316246
pmartin: creating customer-impact note: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/316246-impact
ashley: good. we need a short postmortem skeleton after stabilization: root cause, mitigation, follow-ups (rate-limits, feature-flag rollout circuit breaker, tokenstore autoscale).
eng-ledger: suggest adding a circuit breaker in ff-service for global publishes and a backoff in config-proxy.
ryan_oncall: preparing handoff. Summary for next oncall: 1) config_fallback enabled, 2) ff-service patched to queue publishes, 3) tokenstore quotas increased for svc-edge, 4) monitoring dashboards annotated. Watch p99 for 30m.
incident-bot: created incident record INC-316246 · severity=P1 · started=3162467960
devin: leaving notes: rollback of ff-service global publish is in repo: `releases/rollback-ff-2026-02-14` if we need full revert.
maria: customer list: acct-142, acct-77, acct-991 reported stalls. CS notified.
ryan_oncall: handing off in 8m to @eng-next-oncall. If p99 creeps back above 2.0s or tokenstore >5% 429s, escalate immediately.
pmartin: will keep CS loop updated and post a proactive message to affected customers once stable threshold holds for 15m.
ashley: nice mitigation work. Follow-ups: (1) FF fanout circuit breaker + async publish (owner: devin), (2) tokenstore autoscale + quotas audit (owner: maria), (3) config-proxy cache TTL tuning and fallback testing (owner: ryan_oncall). Please add to the incident doc.
ryan_oncall: handing off now — full log + runbook in the incident doc. next_oncall, please ACK.
eng-ledger: acked. I will monitor for 30m and start the follow-up tasks.
incident-bot: incident INC-316246 updated: status=mitigated · mitigations=[config-fallback, ff-async-queue, tokenstore-quota-bump] · mitigated_at=3162468595
ryan_oncall: closing this thread for live mitigation. Will start a postmortem draft later today. Thanks all. :heart:
